title: FNaF1 Help Wanted ad
claim: The FNaF1 intro newspaper ad says Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, a family pizzeria, is hiring a night security guard (12 am to 6 am) for $120 a week, and disclaims responsibility for injury/dismemberment.
quote: Family pizzeria looking for security guard to work the nightshift. 12 am to 6 am. Monitor cameras, ensure safety of equipment and animatronic characters. Not responsible for injury/dismemberment. $120 a week.

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

notes: Read directly from the in-game intro image (File:FNaF1Newspaper-Updated.png). Phone number is partly cut off in frame ('1-555-FAZ-FAZBEA...'); FNaF2's ad shows 1-555-FAZ-FAZBEAR.

title: Phone Guy worked the office before
claim: The Night 1 caller says he worked in the night-guard office before the player and is finishing his last week.
quote: Um, I actually worked in that office before you. I'm... finishing up my last week now, as a matter of fact

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

title: Fazbear Entertainment liability greeting
claim: Phone Guy reads a Fazbear Entertainment greeting saying that when damage or death occurs, a missing person report will be filed within 90 days or once the premises have been cleaned and bleached and the carpets replaced.
quote: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for damage to property or a person. …

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

title: Animatronics have sung for ~twenty years
claim: Phone Guy jokes that the animatronics have been forced to sing the same songs for twenty years without a bath.
quote: If I were forced to sing those same stupid songs for twenty years and I never got a bath, I'd probably be a bit irritable at night too.

when.label: ~20 years before FNaF1 up to FNaF1
when.basis: Phone Guy: 'for twenty years'

notes: Offhand/hyperbolic phrasing; useful as an approximate age of the FNaF1 characters, not a precise date.

title: Free roaming mode at night
claim: Phone Guy says the animatronics are left in a free roaming mode at night because their servos may lock up if turned off too long.
quote: they're left in some kind of free roaming mode at night. Uh... something about their servos locking up if they get turned off for too long.

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

title: The Bite of '87
claim: Phone Guy says the animatronics used to be allowed to walk around during the day until 'the Bite of '87', and remarks that the human body can live without the frontal lobe.
quote: They used to be allowed to walk around during the day too. But then there was 'The Bite of '87.' Yeah... I-It's amazing that the human body can live without the frontal lobe, you know?

when.label: '87 (assumed 1987)
when.basis: Phone Guy says 'The Bite of '87'; only the two-digit year is given

notes: The game does not say which animatronic bit, who the victim was, or at which location it happened. The frontal-lobe remark implies the victim survived. This is the only explicit Bite reference in FNaF1-3.

title: Guards seen as endoskeletons get stuffed into suits
claim: Phone Guy says the animatronics will likely see a person after hours as a metal endoskeleton without its costume and try to forcefully stuff them into a Freddy Fazbear suit, which would be fatal.
quote: They'll most likely see you as a metal endoskeleton without its costume on. Now since that's against the rules here at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, they'll probably try to... …

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

title: Freddy active in dark; Foxy in Pirate Cove
claim: On Night 2 Phone Guy says Freddy rarely leaves the stage but is more active in the dark, and the character in Pirate Cove becomes more active if the cameras stay off.
quote: Uh, interestingly enough, Freddy himself doesn't come off stage very often. I-I heard he becomes a lot more active in the dark though.

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

title: Most guards don't last this long
claim: On Night 3 Phone Guy says most people don't last this long (then denies implying they died) and suggests playing dead if caught.
quote: Uh most people don't last this long. I mean, you know, th-they usually move on to other things by now. Uh, uh, I'm not implying that they died.

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

title: Phone Guy's last call
claim: On Night 4 Phone Guy says he may not be around tomorrow, asks the player to check inside the suits in the back room, and the call ends with animatronic music, a scream and static while banging is heard.
quote: Uh hey, do me a favor. Uh maybe sometime, uh, you could check inside those suits... ..uh in the back room? Uh, I'm gonna try to hold out until someone...checks.

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

notes: The call ends with the Toreador March (Freddy's in-game jingle), moaning, a scream and static. The wiki transcript labels the scream as Golden Freddy's; the game does not say who attacks him. That he dies is implied, not stated: he never calls again and Night 5's call is garbled voices.

title: Night 5 call is distorted voices
claim: The Night 5 'call' is not Phone Guy: it is deep, distorted voices ending in static and an animatronic screech. These are the same sounds used in the game's hallucinations.

when.label: During FNaF1 (year not stated in game)
when.basis: FNaF1 paychecks print the year as 'xx'; no in-game year given

notes: Fans have matched the reversed audio to an excerpt from 'Autobiography of a Yogi'. That is fan analysis, not stated in the game.

title: Newspaper: 'Kids vanish at local pizzaria'
claim: A rare East Hall Corner newspaper says two local children were lured into a back room at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza on the night of June 26th. Video surveillance identified the man, who was caught the next morning. The children were never found and are presumed dead. Police think he dressed as a company mascot.
quote: Kids vanish at local pizzaria- bodies not found. Two local children were reportedly lured into a back room during the late hours of operation at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza on the night of June 26th.
location: East Hall Corner camera (CAM 4B), rare poster replacement #1

when.label: June 26 (year not given), before FNaF1
when.basis: Clipping says 'the night of June 26th'; no year printed

notes: Headline uses the in-game misspelling 'pizzaria'. The body also says police 'think that the suspect dressed as a company mascot to earn the children's trust.' The killer is unnamed. Tying him to the minigames' purple figure is a later reading, and 'purple-guy' is tagged here only for theory linking. The clipping names 'Freddy Fazbear's Pizza' but does not say it was the FNaF1 building.

title: Newspaper: five children, suspect convicted
claim: A rare East Hall Corner newspaper says five children are now linked to the incident at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where a man dressed as a cartoon mascot lured them into a back room. The suspect was charged, but the bodies were never found.
quote: Five children now reported missing. Suspect convicted. Five children are now linked to the incident at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where a man dressed as a cartoon mascot lured them into a back room. …
location: East Hall Corner camera (CAM 4B), rare poster replacement

when.label: Before FNaF1 (undated)
when.basis: Described as past events; no year given in game

notes: The same clipping adds that the pizzeria 'has been fighting an uphill battle ever since to convince families to return' and quotes: "It's a tragedy." Nuance: the headline says 'convicted' while the body says 'charged'.

title: Newspaper: blood and mucus on mascots
claim: A rare East Hall Corner newspaper says the pizzeria was threatened with shutdown over a foul odor from the mascots, and police were contacted after parents saw what appeared to be blood and mucus around the mascots' eyes and mouths.
quote: Police were contacted when parents reportedly noticed what appeared to be blood and mucus around the eyes and mouths of mascots. One parent alikened them to "reanimated carcasses".
location: East Hall Corner camera (CAM 4B), rare poster replacement

when.label: Before FNaF1 (undated)
when.basis: Described as past events; no year given in game

notes: Headline as printed: 'Local pizzaria theatened with shutdown over sanitation.' (both misspellings are in the game). Wiki notes this variant appears together with the East Hall 'IT'S ME' graffiti.

title: Newspaper: pizzeria to close by year's end
claim: A rare East Hall Corner newspaper says that after a long struggle following the tragedy 'many years ago', Freddy Fazbear's Pizza will close by year's end, and no buyer could be found. The CEO is quoted saying the characters will live on.
quote: After a long struggle to stay in business after the tragedy that struck there many years ago, Freddy Fazbear's Pizza has announced that it will close by year's end. ... "These characters will live on. …
location: East Hall Corner camera (CAM 4B), rare poster replacement

when.label: Year of FNaF1 (closing announced 'by year's end')
when.basis: Clipping describes the tragedy as 'many years ago' and a close 'by year's end'

notes: Headline as printed: 'Local pizzaria said to close by years end.' It also says 'Despite a year-long search for a buyer, companies seem unwilling to be associated with the company.' Wiki notes this variant appears together with the screaming-children drawings.

title: 'IT'S ME' hallucinations
claim: At random (and whenever Golden Freddy appears in the office), 'IT'S ME' flashes on screen with alternating images of a black-eyed Bonnie and a Freddy with human-looking eyes.
quote: IT'S ME

location: West Hall Corner camera (CAM 2B) rare poster; Office

title: FNaF2 Help Wanted ad: Grand Re-Opening

when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

title: New animatronics: facial recognition and criminal database

quote: They've spent a small fortune on these new animatronics, uh, facial recognition, advanced mobility. They even let them walk around during the day! ... …

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)

quote: There's a music box over by the prize counter, and it's rigged to be wound up remotely. ... It doesn't seem to affect all of the animatronics, but it does affect... ..one of them

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

title: Older models from the previous location

quote: by now I'm sure you've noticed the older models... ..sitting in the back room. Uh, those are from the previous location, and we just use them for parts now. ... …

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

title: Foxy twitchy; the puppet is 'always thinking'
claim: Phone Guy says Foxy was always twitchy and may be held off by flashing a light. He says he never liked 'that puppet thing', which is 'always thinking', can go anywhere, and won't be fooled by the Freddy mask.
quote: I'll be honest, I never liked that puppet thing. It's always...thinking, and it can go anywhere. Uh, I don't think the Freddy mask will fool it. So just don't forget the music box.

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

notes: He pauses oddly on Foxy ('did you ever see Foxy the pirate? Oh wait, Foxy... ..oh yeah, Foxy!'). The game gives no reason for this. Fans read it as a veiled Bite reference, but no bite is mentioned.

title: Kid's Cove Foxy became 'the mangle'
claim: On Night 3 Phone Guy says Foxy was remade to be kid-friendly and put in Kid's Cove, but children kept taking it apart, so it was left as a take-apart attraction the staff call 'the mangle'.
quote: So eventually they just stopped trying and left him in some kind of "take apart, put back together" attraction. Now he's just a mess of parts. …

when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

quote: I can personally assure you, that, whatever is going on out there, however tragic it may be, has nothing to do with our establishment.

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

quote: there's been somewhat of an investigation going on, uh, we may end up having to close for a-a few days ... Fazbear Entertainment denies any wrongdoing.

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

title: Original restaurant: Fredbear's Family Diner

quote: Uh, we're gonna try to contact the original restaurant owner. Uh, I think the name of the place was... ..Fredbear's Family Diner or something like that. It was closed for years though

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

notes: First in-game mention of Fredbear's Family Diner. Phone Guy is unsure of the name ('or something like that'). The owner is not named.

title: Someone used the spare yellow suit
claim: On Night 6 Phone Guy says the place is closed because someone used a spare suit from the back, 'a yellow one', and now none of the animatronics are acting right.
quote: Uh, the place is closed down, a-at least for a while. Someone used one of the suits. We had a spare in the back, a yellow one. Someone used it. …

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

notes: Who used the suit and what for is not stated. The yellow suit is not named here. FNaF3 later names a 'Spring Bonnie' suit and shows Fredbear and Spring Bonnie as yellow characters; linking them is a theory step.

title: Final birthday event; guard to day shift
claim: Phone Guy says one more event, a birthday, is scheduled for tomorrow. The guard will work the day shift in uniform, stay close to the animatronics and make sure they don't hurt anyone. Phone Guy says he will probably take the night shift himself when the place reopens.
quote: we have one more event scheduled for tomorrow, a-a birthday. You'll be on day shift. Wear your uniform, stay close to the animatronics and make sure they don't hurt anyone, okay? ... …

when.label: Day after the 11-13-1987 night (c. 11-14-1987)
when.basis: Night 6 overtime check is dated 11-13-1987; birthday is 'tomorrow'

notes: No bite is mentioned in any FNaF2 call. The only explicit Bite reference is FNaF1's 'Bite of '87'. Connecting this birthday to the Bite is a theory inference. Phone Guy's plan to take the night shift fits his FNaF1 statement that he worked that office before.

title: FNaF2 calls never mention a bite
claim: No FNaF2 phone call (Nights 1-6) contains the word 'bite' or describes a bite incident. The only explicit Bite reference in FNaF1-3 is FNaF1 Night 1's 'The Bite of '87'.

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

notes: Negative observation from checking all six call transcripts. Included so the theory layer does not credit FNaF2 with an explicit Bite statement.

title: Jeremy Fitzgerald's paycheck 11-12-1987
claim: Beating Night 5 shows a Fazbear Entertainment check #142 dated 11-12-1987 for $100.50, payable to Jeremy Fitzgerald, memo 'Welcome to the family!'
quote: DATE 11-12-1987 ... PAY TO THE ORDER OF Jeremy Fitzgerald ... One hundred dollars and 50/100 ... MEMO Welcome to the family!

title: Overtime check 11-13-1987 and 'ROBOTS SCRAPPED' article

title: Dream cutscenes end in 'it's me'
claim: Short cutscenes after Nights 2-4 show a first-person view through a Freddy head, facing the original-style Bonnie and Chica. Golden Freddy appears after Night 3 and the Puppet after Night 4. Each ends on a black screen with 'it's me' in the top-left. The first-launch version ends with 'err'.

when.label: November 1987 (FNaF2 week)
when.basis: FNaF2 paychecks are dated 11-12-1987 and 11-13-1987

notes: Whose perspective this is, and whether it is a dream, is not stated in-game. 'End-of-night hallucinations' is book (Freddy Files) wording. The wiki notes the 'it's me' text is barely visible on the black frame.

title: Give Gifts, Give Life minigame
claim: In this random death minigame the player, as the Puppet, first gives gifts ('Give Gifts.') to four grey, dead-looking children. Then ('Give Life.') the player gives each a Freddy, Bonnie, Chica or Foxy mask/head, while a voice spells H-E-L-P-T-H-E-M. It ends with Golden Freddy's jumpscare, and a fifth body is visible for one frame before it.
quote: Give Gifts. / Give Life.

when.label: Past event depicted in a FNaF2 minigame (undated)
when.basis: Minigame gives no date

notes: The game shows the masks placed on the children. That this 'puts them inside' the animatronics is an interpretation. The fifth body appears only for a frame.

title: Take Cake to the Children minigame
claim: Playing as Freddy, the player serves cake to six children ('Take cake to the children.') while a grey child cries outside. A purple car pulls up, a purple figure gets out and kills the crying child, then leaves. A voice spells S-A-V-E-H-I-M and the minigame ends with the Puppet's jumpscare.
quote: Take cake to the children.
location: Death minigame 'Take Cake to the Children'

when.label: Past event depicted in a FNaF2 minigame (undated)
when.basis: Minigame gives no date

notes: The victim is unnamed and has no stated gender in FNaF2, while the audio says 'SAVE HIM'. The 'henrys-daughter' id is the site's descriptor for this child and comes from later games; FNaF2 says nothing about her family. The Puppet jumpscare at the end is a presentational link only.

title: Foxy Go! Go! Go! minigame
claim: Playing as Foxy, the player repeatedly leaves a curtained stage ('Get Ready!') to cheering children. On the third run a smiling purple figure stands in the starting room and the children lie dead. The minigame ends with the old Foxy's jumpscare.

when.label: Past event depicted in a FNaF2 minigame (undated)
